messages:
mike: kicking off canary enable for model v2.9 on catalog. targeting 5% traffic, 10m warmup, then step to 20% if no regressions. watch latency, token cost, and rerank score deltas

deploy-bot: deploy started → catalog.enable(model: "m2-llama-quant", variant: "v2.9", percent: 5)

deploy-bot: health checks passing on 3/3 hosts, avg p95 latency: 180ms

sophia: can we change fallback ordering so quantized variants prefer the low-latency raft before cpu-fallback?

jia: yes — propose fallback ladder: [m2-llama-quant, m2-llama-fp16, m1-llama-legacy]. moving cpu fallback last should reduce noisy regressions

oliver: seeing small drift in rerank top-1 for ecommerce queries (+2.2%). flagging

mike: what's the baseline? can we get a diff from the eval harness?

oliver: baseline 0.1% last week. quick diff sample:
```diff
- user: which size fits me best? -> model: "m1" -> result: size L
+ user: which size fits me best? -> model: "m2-llama-quant" -> result: size XL
```

sophia: looks prompt-sensitive. recommend pinning route "product.recommend" to v2.8 and expanding tests

mike: applying soft-pin: product.recommend -> v2.8 for 30m

deploy-bot: pin applied: route=product.recommend -> pinned_to=v2.8 duration=30m

auto-monitor: anomaly alert (rerank-delta) on product.recommend, threshold=1.5% breached

mike: pausing canary, rolling back partial traffic to 0% while we triage. next: 1) collect eval diffs 2) run quant disabled tests 3) re-evaluate fallback ordering

jia: i'll run quick quant toggle: `./scripts/eval_quant_toggle.sh --model m2-llama-quant --off`

oliver: running local repro, logs s3://redwood-logs/catalog/repro/2056789012

sophia: for long-context routes prefer fp16 early. drafting guardrail: if route-length>1024 prefer fp16 over quant

mike: @infra-team please validate kernel perf traces and pin kernel versions if needed

infra-monitor: ack — pulling op-level traces now, ETA ~25m

mike: thanks. i'll post rollout follow-up with diffs and traces and a short retro after rollback to capture guardrails and pin defaults :thumbsup:
